title: The Shawn-Language Law
principle: Nutshell first in plain words, record second, execution details last — never make him decode.

source.context: His standing communication standard: plain words or the output failed.

evidence.note: 'If he has to ask what something means, the output failed.'

applicability.situations: Anything addressed to Shawn, especially asks and reports.
applicability.decisions: How to order and word any message to him.

status_history.note: Seed migration from AGENTS.md standing laws, 2026-10-11.

graduation.next_step: Stays in briefing — language judgment resists mechanization.
